o.text: From soyut- (“to cool”) + -ucu. Calque of Russian холоди́льник (xolodílʹnik).
Internationalism; ultimately from French molécule, itself derived from New Latin molecula.
From bur- + -ğu. Cognate with Turkish burgu (“screw, auger”), Chagatai بورغو (burğu, “screw, drill, auger”), Kazakh бұрғы (burğı, “drill bit, auger”).
